summary: Defines and manages service codes within the system, including their categorization and localization based on user settings.
purpose: Manage service codes used throughout the system, localized for language settings.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the service code

fields.name: CodeCategoryID
fields.description: Identifier for the category of the code

fields.name: ShortName
fields.description: Abbreviated name of the service code

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Full description of the service code

fields.name: SortOrder
fields.description: Order in which the service code is displayed

fields.name: Notes
fields.description: Additional information about the service code

business_rules.name: Localization
business_rules.description: Apply alternative language fields based on user session settings
